text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for g-prod-nv - GPU pool saturation. queue_length=1240, evictions=320, avg_latency_tokens=230ms. autoscaler attempted 3 scale-ups but failed with rate_limit/quotas. tagging oncall.

alice: ack - joining. can someone paste autoscaler error? stack?

sam: looking. autoscaler logs show repeated 429s from cloud api followed by 'scale request rejected - quota_exceeded'. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T09:04:12Z autoscaler: request_scale_up(pool=g-prod-nv, delta=6) -> 429 RateLimit
2026-03-15T09:04:13Z autoscaler: request_scale_up(pool=g-prod-nv, delta=6) -> 403 QuotaExceeded: GPU quota 200/200
2026-03-15T09:04:18Z autoscaler: backoff 30s
```

maya: also seeing driver Xid bursts on a subset of nodes - causes transient node flaps and evictions. kernel logs from node g-prod-nv-17: 
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, PID 4321 
[ 1234.568012] gpu0: segfault trace... oom_kill_process: pid=4321 
[ 1234.569120] eviction: vm_overcommit -> trigger kms reset
```

raj: that aligns with pool effective capacity shrink. autoscaler sees nodes flapping and refuses to place new allocations - plus cloud quota blocks new instances. we need quick mitigation: reduce incoming load to this pool, reroute heavy customers. can ops open reroute?

nina: confirmed - project quota for GPUs in region us-west2 is at cap. we can request quota increase but multi-hour. ephemeral option: provision nodes in us-central and route. however some customers pinned to us-west2 for latency.

jasper: rolling a driver restart and kernel module reload on flapping nodes now - patch applied to daemonset that adds a 45s drain and kubelet restart. running command: 
```bash
kubectl -n infra rollout restart daemonset/gpu-driver-hotfix -l pool=g-prod-nv
# watch nodes: kubectl get nodes -l pool=g-prod-nv -o wide
```

alice: good. also throttling input at the gateway for high-token routes to reduce queue growth. pushing a short-lived rate limit: 60rps -> 30rps for /v1/generate on g-prod-nv routing key. who will own customer comms?

sre-lead: I will. need impact summary: which tenants affected, error profiles (timeouts vs 429s), and ETA for mitigations. alice/sam please assemble.

sam: temporary mitigation status:
- driver restart: in progress 6/12 nodes recycled, nodes reporting stable after module reload
- autoscaler: still blocked by quota for new instances; backoff in autoscaler logs
- routing throttle: deployed at 09:12 UTC, queue growth flattened from +400/min to +40/min

maya: after restart, flapping nodes stopped reporting Xid spikes. CPU on remaining healthy nodes went up, but no new OOMs yet. kernel messages show reduced resets. monitoring: GPU utilization still high ~92% but stable.

nina: raising an emergency quota request with cloud - submitted ticket #CLOUD-7219, support notified. may be expedited but not guaranteed. while waiting, can create temporary burst in us-central with cross-region routing - need approval for cost.

pj-notes: (ops bot note) manual scale up blocked: quota_exceeded - want to retry?

raj: do not retry until driver stabilization finishes. risk of more flaps will waste new instances. prioritize driver fix + routing.

alice: agreed. sam, take primary for oncall until 09:45 UTC. handing off: current state, driver restarts ongoing, throttle active, cloud quota in progress. please update pager every 5 minutes and call if Xid returns.

sam: taking over. status update 09:22 UTC: queue length=820, evictions=140, applied throttle showing 2xx for most traffic, a few retries 503. notifying top 5 tenants with potential latency blips.

sre-lead: customer impact note for postmortem: affected customers saw increased latency and 503s during window 09:02-09:20 UTC. no data loss, requests retried. ops escalations: quota + driver instability reduced effective capacity by ~30%. we will include mitigation timeline in incident report.

jasper: finished rollout on remaining nodes at 09:30 UTC. verified kernel messages quiet, Xid counts dropped to baseline.

sam: queue down to 120, GPU util ~70%, autoscaler still showing quota errors but stable now. will leave throttle in place for 30m and then ramp back.

alice: thanks team. handback to oncall rotation: I am back on. follow-up action items:
- request permanent quota increase (nina)
- postmortem draft (sre-lead + alice)
- bake driver health checks into autoscaler flow so flapping nodes excluded (maya/eng-runtime)
- emergency cross-region routing playbook (raj/ops)

sre-lead: closing note: incident declared resolved at 09:38 UTC. no ongoing customer outages. will open postmortem and attach logs. :thumbsup:
